scope: P3a real command acceptance with synthetic sources and isolated Career-Ops data; no retention, acquisition, scoring or persistence runs
failures: The combined command must preserve the old combine, run-contract, resolve, plan and final contract boundaries and business partitions
A source summary count mismatch stops before resolution or planning and retains source evidence
A missing required exclusion audit fails the post-combine run contract before resolution or planning
Frozen source config drift remains rejected before any derived artifact is written
A real resolver write failure after canonical enrichment stops planning, leaves evidence, and can be repaired and rerun
A missing candidate source, invalid runtime or location policy drift stops planning after resolution, leaving the standalone planner recovery path available
An existing resolution ledger is never overwritten by the whole command without explicit force; force archives it and reuses ordinary boundaries
Existing assignments, rendered reports or receipt prohibit whole-command recombine even with force and preserve every run file
Standalone planner resume still rejects changed candidate facts, scoring rules and runtime rather than silently rebuilding the plan
Explicit runtime and exact-key blacklist overrides reach the planner without broadening their established semantics
Missing, unknown, duplicate or valueless CLI options are rejected before mutation; the new CLI has no full-snapshot mode
Successful preparation emits bounded READY metadata and paths, leaves candidate snapshots in assignments only, and creates no scoring, cleanup or persistence artifacts
